releases.notes:
* Added **26.3** support.
* [Overflowing Bars](https://modrinth.com/mod/overflowing-bars) Compatability: FHB will now disable it's internal health bar rendering when Overflowing Bars is installed. You can use Overflowing Bars combined with the Vanilla particles! ([#28](https://github.com/ehilynxin/FancyHealthBar/issues/28))

* Fixed 32x (or higher) resolution resource packs not working with Vanilla ([#26](https://github.com/efekos/FancyHealthBar/issues/26))
* The mod now requires any version of the Fabric API. It would previously assume you had Fabric API installed and be vulnerable to crashes if you didn't have it.
* The mod no longer requires a specific version of the Fabric Loader ([#27](https://github.com/efekos/FancyHealthBar/issues/27))
* Added **26.2** support.

* Added **26.1.2** support.
* Fixed a bug where scissored Line Bar styles like Pixelated wouldn't work with offsets.

* Fixed Polytone crashing when used with FHB ([#22](https://github.com/efekos/FancyHealthBar/issues/22)). **This is more like a workaround and FHB will most likely conflict with Polytone. Please report any bugs you see to [here](https://github.com/efekos/FancyHealthBar/issues)!**
* Fixed Line Bar's Delta Behavior option `Jump` not fading away in versions 1.21.6 and above
* Added **Fade In Ticks** and **Fade Out Ticks** to Vanilla
* Added **1.21.11**, **26.1** and **26.1.1** Support
* Added **Line** and **Thin** Line styles for Line Bar
* Added Offset options ([#16](https://github.com/efekos/FancyHealthBar/issues/16))

* Fixed refmaps having wrong names and causing the game to crash ( #19 )
* **New Known Bug: Using Polytone will crash the game.** A solution for this bug, along with a few new features, will be released in the next update.
